description: Backend fixes: CORS config www subdomain, health endpoint dual-prefix registration, subscription graceful degradation verification, and service worker cache version bump
steps: Step 1 - Backend CORS (apps/backend/app/config.py): Change the default value of ALLOWED_ORIGINS from 'https://syrabit.ai,https://app.syrabit.ai' to 'https://syrabit.ai,https://www.syrabit.ai,https://app.syrabit.ai'.

Step 2 - Backend health endpoint path (apps/backend/app/main.py): Add a second router registration for the health router so it also responds on /api/v1/health: `app.include_router(health.router, prefix='/api/v1/health', tags=['Health'])`. Place it after the existing `app.include_router(health.router, prefix='/health', tags=['Health'])` line.

Step 3 - Subscription graceful degradation (apps/backend/app/api/v1/subscription.py): The code already handles PaymentNotConfiguredError and returns 503 with 'Payment service not configured'. Verify this is correct - no changes needed if already handled properly.

Step 4 - Chat graceful degradation (apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py): The chat endpoint already has comprehensive error handling for AI service failures (RuntimeError, httpx.HTTPStatusError, TimeoutError). No changes needed - the existing error handling already returns clear error responses (502/503/504) when services are unavailable.
Step 5 - Service Worker cache version bump (apps/frontend/public/sw.js): Change `const CACHE_VERSION = '15';` to `const CACHE_VERSION = '16';`.
acceptance_criteria: apps/backend/app/main.py registers health.router at both /health and /api/v1/health prefixes
Python syntax is valid for all modified backend files
Subscription endpoint already returns 503 for missing payment config (confirmed, no code change needed)
Chat endpoint already returns clear errors for missing AI services (confirmed, no code change needed)
verification: Run `python -m py_compile apps/backend/app/config.py` to verify syntax
Run `python -m py_compile apps/backend/app/main.py` to verify syntax
findings: Steps 3 and 4 required no code changes. Subscription endpoint already catches PaymentNotConfiguredError and returns HTTP 503. Chat endpoint already has comprehensive error handling for RuntimeError (502/503/504), httpx.HTTPStatusError (502), asyncio.TimeoutError (504), and generic Exception (500). Used python3 instead of python for syntax checks (pyenv required explicit version).
